verdict.rationale: Auth0's log streaming service (auth0-docs-12/27/47/58) lets developers export tenant logs — including auth events — in near real-time to external log-analysis/webhook-style destinations, which can be used to keep other systems in sync, and Actions can trigger custom logic on login/signup events. However, the evidence never explicitly documents a webhook subscription model scoped to specific event types (sign-up, sign-in, user changes) as a first-class event-stream API. Missing for 10: explicit webhook endpoint documentation, granular event-type subscription docs, and independent/hands-on confirmation of reliable real-time sync use.
